body:
Audio, chat, and CQ-to-CQ features broken in production due to Supabase client infrastructure returning nullable types, incomplete mock chains crashing on unconfigured environments, and `next/font/google` failing builds when Google Fonts CDN is unreachable.

### Supabase client null safety
- `createClient()` in both browser and server modules returned `T | null` ΓÇö every downstream consumer (`useChat`, `useSession`, `useDirectMessages`, `useFriends`, `AuthContext`) inherited the null uncertainty
- Fixed return type to guarantee non-null; 152 ΓåÆ 0 TypeScript errors

### Complete mock query builder
- Mock client only supported `.select().eq().single()` ΓÇö callers using `.order()`, `.limit()`, `.maybeSingle()`, `.insert()`, `.channel()` crashed at runtime

```ts
// Before: crashes on any chain method not explicitly mocked
from: () => ({ select: () => ({ eq: () => ({ single: async () => ... }) }) })

// After: generic chainable builder
function createMockQueryBuilder() {
  const builder = {}
  for (const method of ['select','insert','update','eq','order','limit','range',...])
    builder[method] = () => builder
  builder.single = async () => ({ data: null, error: mockError })
  builder.maybeSingle = async () => ({ data: null, error: null })
  return builder
}
```

### Undefined env var handling
- `admin.ts`, `session/route.ts`, `middleware.ts`, `webauthn.ts`, `engine/memory.ts` all passed potentially `undefined` `ENV.supabase.url` / `serviceRoleKey` to `createClient()` ΓÇö added placeholder fallbacks with early-exit guards

### Build resilience
- Replaced `next/font/google` Inter import (blocks entire build if CDN unreachable) with CSS `@import url(...)` ΓÇö non-blocking, body already uses `var(--font-sans)` system font stack

### Missing CQ-to-CQ exports
- `supabase-client.ts` was missing 14 function exports (`getContacts`, `sendMessage`, `getNotifications`, `initiateCall`, `getOrCreateConversation`, etc.) referenced by hooks and modules ΓÇö added implementations with null guards
